outcome.technical: plugins/audit/hooks/_config.py: three narrowings of the house lift's preconditions, nothing widened. (1) _house_body_end returns None when any body line ends in a backslash (bash 3.2 joins backslash-newline inside $( before it finds the heredoc end). (2) _house_body_end returns None when the text after the argument's closing `)"` holds a `)` anywhere, on any line; a second house argument holds one, so a command lifts one body at most. (3) _house_script_word trusts the audit-task carrier only as "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/manifest/audit-task.py" in double quotes (single quotes would name a literal directory in the cwd; unquoted, the scanner already refuses the brace, as before) or a literal absolute path whose realpath equals the script under hook_plugin_root(); the name is built from the stem plus os.extsep, so no script-name literal lands in hooks/ (mv37 green). _HOUSE_FRAME_GIT comment no longer lists a hook among what the lift refuses: a commit-msg hook running the message is named as the replay class, a property of the consumer the lift does not claim to close. lift_house_bodies docstring lists the new preconditions.
